channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Drupal
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Drupal, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now: Drupal Core: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions
item.description:
Drupal Core: exploited from day 0 · fix: 10.6.23, 11.3.23, 11.4.14 · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update Drupal Core to the fixed version for your release line (for example 10.6.23, 11.3.23 or 11.4.14).

Drupal Core contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to take over a site via the exposed Drupal installer when the site is in one of the affected unusual or incomplete installation states.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-136716

item.title: Patch now (update): Drupal Core: Remote Code Execution
item.description:
Drupal Core: RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 · fix: 10.6.22, 11.3.22, 11.4.13

First step: Update Drupal Core to the fixed version for your release line (for example 10.6.22, 11.3.22 or 11.4.13).

Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-132165

item.title: Patch: Drupal Commerce Core Vulnerability Exploited Against Online Stores
item.description:
Drupal Commerce Core: Broken access control · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited from day 0 (news only) · fix: 2.41, 3.3.13

First step: Update Drupal Commerce Core to 2.41 or 3.3.13 or later.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Commerce Core allows Forceful Browsing.

Medium · Fix available · CVE-2026-118539
